summary: Smooths or sharpens CHOP samples by combining each sample with weighted neighbor samples, with filter types for Gaussian, Box, Edge, Sharpen, De-spike, Ramp Preserve, and One Euro behavior.
key_concepts: Filters by combining each sample with a range of neighboring samples; the Type parameter selects the weighting behavior.
Width and Width Unit determine the neighbor window, smoothing strength, and delay introduced by most filter types.
Effect blends between the original and filtered channels so plans can soften the filter without rebuilding the network.
De-spike, Ramp Preserve, and One Euro modes use their dedicated tolerance, rate, cutoff, speed, and slope controls.
Filter per Sample changes multi-sample channel behavior by filtering each sample independently instead of across the whole channel.

key_params.name: type
key_params.note: Filter algorithm such as Gaussian, Box, Edge Detect, Sharpen, De-spike, Ramp Preserve, or One Euro

key_params.name: effect
key_params.note: Blend amount for the filter effect

key_params.name: width
key_params.note: Neighbor-sample window used by the filter

key_params.name: widthunit
key_params.note: Width units: samples, frames, or seconds

key_params.name: passes
key_params.note: Number of times the filter is applied

key_params.name: speedcoeff
key_params.note: One Euro speed coefficient for high-speed lag

key_params.name: filterpersample
key_params.note: Filter each sample independently for multi-sample channels

common_gotchas: Gaussian and Box filters delay the output by half the filter size; De-spike delays by the full filter size.
Left Half Gaussian and Left Half Box avoid the future-sample delay by using samples back in time.
The official filter type parameter is named type, not filtertype.
Use Audio Filter CHOP, Band EQ CHOP, or Parametric EQ CHOP for most sound-filtering plans.
One Euro tuning trades slow-speed jitter reduction against fast-motion lag through cutoff, slope cutoff, and speed coefficient.
Filter per Sample changes how multi-sample channels are interpreted, so test time-sliced or multi-sample inputs explicitly.
